::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 3d 1864  
**From:** Testwood  
**Manuscript:** British Library Add MSS 54920: 34
:::

Miss Yonge would be much obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](organizations/other_111.qmd) would send a copy of each of her works to the [Vnble Archdeacon Badnell](people/person_90.qmd)[^1]
Care of H J Dunell Esq
4 Upper Hyde Park Gardens W[^2]

---

[^1]: The Ven. Hopkins Badnall (1821- 1892) was Archdeacon of George in South Africa, and later Bishop of Cape Town, which accounts for his correspondence being forwarded. CMY was probably presenting the books to a school.
[^2]: On the reverse is a list of book titles in CMY’s writing: ‘History of Christian Names/ The Heir of Redclyffe/ Dynevor Terrace/ Daisy Chain/ Heartsease/ Hopes and Fears/ Young Stepmother/ Lances of Lynwood/ Little Duke / Marie Theresè of Lamourous’. These have been ticked in pencil and 'sent by I.D.C. Sept 5’ is noted.
